verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs show #tags as a working organization and retrieval mechanism: advanced search can filter notes by #tags, and Kindle sync auto-tags imported notes as #book. Nothing in the evidence shows typed properties or structured metadata fields on notes, so only the tag half of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: typed properties/metadata fields, documentation of tag management (hierarchies, renaming, consistency tooling), independent or hands-on corroboration of tag workflows.
